senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. חָשַׁב) [to whisper, v. Fl. to Levy Talm. Dict. II, p. 459,] to think, devise, v. כּוּשְׁפָּא.

units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 43a">Snh. 43ᵃ</cite> (suppressed in later eds., v. <cite ref="J00680"><he>יֵשׁוּ</he></cite>) <he>על שכי׳ והסית וכ׳</he> because he practiced sorcery and enticed &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 7:4">Ib. VII, 4</cite> <he>המְכַשֵּׁף</he> he who practices witchcraft, expl.

<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 7:11">ib. 11</cite> <he>המכ׳ העושה מעשה וכ׳</he> he who produces a real effect is guilty, not he who produces an optical delusion, v. <cite ref="A01021"><he>אָחַז</he></cite>; a. fr.—V. <cite ref="M01443"><he>מְכַשֵּׁף</he></cite>. <cite ref="M01444"><he>מְכַשֵּׁפָה</he></cite>.
